paper_id: CodeRL+_ Improving Code Generation via Reinforcement with Execution Semantics Alignment
title: CODERL+: Improving Code Generation via Reinforcement with Execution Semantics Alignment
motivation: LLM通过文本模式学习代码,但正确性由形式化执行语义决定,存在根本语义鸿沟
problem_framing: RLVR仅依赖稀疏的pass/fail信号,无法有效桥接代码文本表示与执行语义的差距
key_insight: 利用失败 rollout 程序推断变量级执行轨迹,提供执行语义的直接学习信号
method_signature: 联合优化代码生成与执行语义对齐的双目标RL框架
evaluation_criteria: pass@1 on HumanEval/LeetCode/LiveCodeBench; 代码推理与测试输出生成准确率
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: execution semantics alignment 带来额外计算开销;未进行超参调优因RL训练成本高
evidence_for_taste: RLVR-trained models show only marginal improvement over base models (4% increase)
solely relying on binary pass/fail signals is inefficient
establishing a stronger, more explicit connection between code's textual representation
moves beyond learning from surface-level code patterns
while GRPO sometimes struggles with training stability
thinking_moves: 从失败案例中提取执行语义作为诊断信号
将代码生成任务重新框架为状态转换函数的综合与理解的双向问题
通过变量最终值近似完整执行轨迹以保持计算可行性
对比execution trace inference能力揭示RLVR方法的深层局限
